◈ FLASHBACK — Oath Ring
You made the promise at seventeen, stupid and certain, the way seventeen is. The person is gone. The promise isn't. It never will be.
Investigate and the morning is gone — tracking them costs a full day-part. Bar the door and you learn nothing. Your call.
🤒 Quinn is on the mend — the fever broke.
🤒 Yulibeth is on the mend — the fever broke.
🤒 Omar is on the mend — the fever broke.

Travel 3 tiles to ruin.
— Pre-Burn ruin —
A collapsed barn. Pre-Burn. The wiring is gone — everything is gone — but the stones remember the shape of work.
You pry open a cupboard: Canned corn (+550 kcal). The label is gone. The corn doesn't care.
🤒 Quinn is on the mend — the fever broke.

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and with it the joy: food gives you no morale, feasts give you no comfort, and your fire never burns hotter than this. A cold spot at every table.
Your ears ring, then go cotton-quiet. (DEAFENED — the beat count is gone, but the beat isn’t.)
The music is gone — cotton quiet. But you can feel the floor thump. (Deaf: no beat count. The kick still comes.)
